decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed was heavily saturated with accessories like travel cases and charging cables, which narrowed the selection of actual speakers. From the available speakers, I identified five serious options ranging from budget to high-end. The Edifier (prod_bluetooth_speakers_037) and Harman Kardon (prod_bluetooth_speakers_116) offer premium audio but are at significantly higher price points ($399 and $159 respectively). The MusiBaby (prod_bluetooth_speakers_151) is affordable but had mixed reviews regarding volume. I chose the Raymate (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) as the final selection because it boasts the highest rating (4.6) among the portable speakers at a very competitive mid-range price of $39.99, with reviews specifically praising its power and portability.
